tasks.title: Verify two-client analysis and rename journeys
tasks.goal: Prove independent external clients can navigate, edit unsaved state and perform the saved-state rename protocol.
steps: Create two independent headless protocol clients with separate contexts/overlays and negotiated encodings, using implemented services rather than direct private helper calls.
Run inspect to unsaved edit to diagnostics/preview without disk effects; exercise created/deleted/moved buffers, partial syntax, stale pages and watch gaps.
Perform reviewed package rename only after explicit saves/fresh plan and both edit-barrier acknowledgements; inject competing buffer/disk edits and verify refusal/post-state navigation.
positive_cases: Client A's unsaved changes never contaminate B's capture.
Successful saved rename regenerates a source tree both clients can navigate.
negative_cases: A test bypasses transport validation by calling an internal helper.
Cross-client conflict metadata exposes another client's buffer content.

tasks.title: Verify long jobs, replay, cancellation and revoked inspection
tasks.goal: Exercise failure and connection boundaries through independent external clients without duplicate effects.
steps: Submit identical admitted jobs concurrently through separate adapters and simulate lost responses, EOF, owner crash, restart and expired namespace/result retention.
Assert queries/control remain responsive, same-key attach never duplicates production, conflicting keys refuse and replay gaps resnapshot with retained terminal/partial identity.
Cancel before and after effects, resolve typed input/admission, revoke a contributed provider and inspect its captured schemas/results without execution.
positive_cases: A durable outcome survives API restart and event payload expiry.
Cancellation reports either reached safe stop or exact partial/recovery effects.
negative_cases: Expired dedup payload permits effect replay.
Revocation erases unique retained evidence or triggers the revoked native reader.

tasks.title: Verify external HOME image and service actions
tasks.goal: Close the M-15-inclusive external path with the same operation and provenance contracts as initial domains.
steps: Use two headless clients to inspect a HOME generation, prepare/update/verify it and navigate command ownership to source/producer evidence.
Prepare and run an isolated Docker rebuild/replacement with responsive progress/reconnect/cancel handling and exact runtime-data boundaries.
Discover service descriptors, perform admitted read/write and denied effects, rotate bindings and verify partial/error/health states plus retained no-GitHub evidence; clean exact fixture resources.
positive_cases: The same client contract spans HOME generation, image stage and service operation.
A Docker replacement or service denial is inspectable through linked domain evidence.
negative_cases: A supported runtime action still requires CLI text/TUI scripting.
A headless test contacts real model services/public registries or exposes host HOME/socket.
